goal: Prevent untrusted inputs like rejected RPC calls from forging fake log lines in debug.log
Stop callers from misleading node operators or triggering false positives in monitoring tools
agreement: Substantive support with all prior objections settled
Favored global newline escaping over call-site string sanitization (davidgumberg, ryanofsky)
Verified log injection prevention through manual testing (polespinasa)
Settled objection on broken multiline logs by outputting individual lines instead of blocking (maflcko)
Code review approval for test coverage of special characters and Windows behavior (ryanofsky)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it stops untrusted inputs from forging critical debug log errors like tip connection failures
Protects node operators and automated monitoring tools against spoofed diagnostic lines
